note: Submodule of search_api_opensearch. Provides a Search API data type plugin with id 'location' (label Geopoint, GeoPointDataType, uses geofield.geophp) and a DataTypeEventSubscriber that answers the parent module's SupportsDataTypeEvent to mark 'location' supported by the OpenSearch backend. Depends on search_api_opensearch + geofield. No settings/permissions/config schema. This site has no live OpenSearch cluster, so medium/hard cases are grounded in a real search_api.index config: a geofield on node indexed with the 'location' data type. Introspection reads the field's data type; execution changes an index field's data type to 'location'. Artifacts namespaced field_saol_geo / saol_*.

evals.prompt: What does the search_api_opensearch_location module add to Search API OpenSearch, and what is the machine id of the data type it provides?
evals.expected_output: It adds a Search API data type with id 'location' (label 'Geopoint') that indexes geofield latitude/longitude values into OpenSearch as a geo_point.

evals.prompt: Which contrib module must be installed for search_api_opensearch_location, and what kind of field data does it turn into a searchable geopoint?
evals.expected_output: It depends on the geofield module (plus search_api_opensearch) and turns geofield latitude/longitude values into an OpenSearch geo_point.

evals.prompt: How does search_api_opensearch_location make the OpenSearch backend accept its 'location' data type?
evals.expected_output: A DataTypeEventSubscriber subscribes to the parent module's SupportsDataTypeEvent and calls setIsSupported(TRUE) when the type is 'location', so the OpenSearch backend maps it to a geo_point.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Search API index saol_med_idx indexes a geographic field. What Search API data type is the field_saol_geo field configured with? Inspect the live index configuration.
evals.expected_output: location - search_api.index.saol_med_idx field_settings.field_saol_geo.type is 'location' (the Geopoint data type from search_api_opensearch_location).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Search API index 'saol_task' has a geographic field field_saol_geo currently indexed as a plain string. Change that index field so it is indexed as a geopoint using the data type provided by search_api_opensearch_location. Apply the change to the live index configuration.
evals.expected_output: search_api.index.saol_task field_settings.field_saol_geo.type is set to 'location' (e.g. load the Index, getField('field_saol_geo')->setType('location') and save).
